services.desc: Upcycled featured works made by artists who repurpose commonplace, discarded, or unexpected materials to make detailed and surprising works of art. In this VanGo exhibition, featured artist Victoria Fuller’s work examines the connections between humanity and nature. Each piece illuminates a different aspect of the relationship between those two forces, which Fuller describes as, “a delicate balance”. The VanGo has been inhabited by an army of imaginary organisms. Scientists believe they have escaped from the dreams of three artists. It’s time to investigate!
